_comment: WHY Loculus PAPER engine. Signals come ONLY from /opt/why-yellow-markshadow (Yellow mark-candle shadow). Bybit is used for PUBLIC market data only. Nothing here can place an order.

sizing._comment: Production Yellow book runs a fixed $2000 clip on $25000 equity (8.0% of starting equity) at 10x. The demo keeps the SAME ratio on the $1000 demo balance: fixed $80 notional per position, max 8 open (production WY_MAX_OPEN). Qty is rounded DOWN to the Bybit qtyStep; if that yields 0 the Bybit minOrderQty is used and the real resulting notional is recorded on the trade.

bybit_costs._comment: Same assumptions as the WHY Bybit research configuration (/etc/systemd/system/why-bybit.service WB_TAKER_BPS/WB_MAKER_BPS/WB_SPREAD_BPS): Bybit linear VIP0 taker 5.5 bps, maker 2.0 bps, 2.0 bps slippage on every TAKER fill beyond the touch. Entries fill at the live executable side (long=ask, short=bid) + slippage, taker fee. TARGET exits are modelled as a resting limit at the target (fill AT the target when the executable side reaches it, maker fee, no slippage). STOP / TIMEOUT exits fill at the executable side (long=bid, short=ask) + slippage, taker fee.

signals._comment: A signal older than max_signal_age_s at the time it is first seen (e.g. produced while this service was down) is recorded as SKIPPED/stale and never executed at a later price.
